cards.title: MARKET CRIER
cards.concept: bareheaded market crier in a grey pinstripe waistcoat and rolled shirtsleeves, one hand raised mid-call, a sheaf of tally sheets and a stub of chalk held at his chest
cards.hook: his career started in stockbroking: calling trades before anyone else

cards.title: WANDERING BARD
cards.concept: charismatic wandering bard in a plain grey travelling coat with an open collar, a worn lute slung across his chest and a knowing half-smile
cards.hook: the silver tongue of a born salesman; suave and smooth vibe

cards.title: MASTER TAILOR
cards.concept: sharp village master tailor in an impeccably cut charcoal waistcoat, measuring tape draped round his neck, shears and a pincushion held at his chest
cards.hook: the dark suit in his photo: always the best-dressed man in the room

cards.title: NET MENDER
cards.concept: harbour net mender in a grey fisherman's jumper, a knotted rope net and wooden shuttle held at his chest, coils of rope over one shoulder
cards.hook: networking pun: his Cisco work at Accenture UK, keeping every link tied

cards.title: HORSE TRADER
cards.concept: confident fairground horse trader in a leather jerkin and grey neckerchief, a bridle over his shoulder and a hand extended for the deal-sealing handshake
cards.hook: sales from day one: nobody walks away from his handshake without a deal

cards.title: CARAVAN MASTER
cards.concept: caravan master in a green-lined travelling cloak with a brass compass on a chain and a rolled trade-route map held at his chest
cards.hook: Country Business Manager at Digital Realty UK: growing trade across a whole realm

cards.title: RANGER SCOUT
cards.concept: ranger scout with his green hood thrown back, leather bracers, a longbow behind his shoulders and a spyglass held at his chest
cards.hook: business development: first to spot a new market on the horizon

cards.title: FENCING MASTER
cards.concept: suave fencing master in a fitted dark doublet with green piping, rapier raised in a salute before his bearded face, a cool confident smirk
cards.hook: closes deals with finesse; the smooth, confident vibe

cards.title: RAVEN COURIER
cards.concept: trusted courier in a dark riding coat with a green sash, a sleek raven familiar perched on his shoulder and a wax-sealed letter at his chest
cards.hook: the connector: carries word between kingdoms, the heart of partnerships

cards.title: ROYAL ENVOY
cards.concept: royal envoy in a fine dark doublet trimmed in teal, a teal sash of office, presenting a sealed treaty scroll that glows faintly teal at the seal
cards.hook: Director of Sales & Partnerships: the realm's chosen dealmaker

cards.title: CITADEL KEEPER
cards.concept: keeper of a fortress in teal-accented plate, a great iron key held at his chest, behind him towers whose windows glow teal like rows of server racks
cards.hook: Digital Realty data centres: guardian of the realm's vaults

cards.title: BULL MARKET KNIGHT
cards.concept: knight in teal-edged steel with bull-horn pauldrons, bareheaded to show his cropped hair and beard, a pennant lance with a charging-bull crest behind him
cards.hook: stockbroking roots: he only rides a bull market

cards.title: WARLOCK DIPLOMAT
cards.concept: silver-tongued warlock diplomat in an ornate dark velvet coat, violet flame dancing in his open palm, a glowing pact contract with violet rune sigils floating at his chest, eyes glinting violet
cards.hook: deal closer: every partnership he signs is a binding pact

cards.title: MONOLITH LORD
cards.concept: lord in violet-runed black iron armour before a humming citadel of towering obsidian monoliths crackling with violet lightning, a rune-etched sceptre held at his chest
cards.hook: Digital Realty: ruler of a realm of great halls that hum day and night

cards.title: EMPEROR OF ALLIANCES
cards.concept: radiant emperor in gold and white ceremonial regalia with a slim golden laurel crown over his cropped hair, a glowing golden handshake sigil at his chest, allied kingdom banners and a golden data-fortress skyline behind him in a blazing gold aura
cards.hook: his ultimate form: partnerships and data-centre empire united, every kingdom an ally
